C1.worst_defect: The first thing above the headline is the badge "Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0", which assumes the visitor already knows there is a plugin; someone who half knows Vendure only learns two lines later that a server plugin exists, and the British word "till" carries the whole hero sentence without being glossed.
C1.where: home/desktop/01 and home/phone/01 (hero badge and lead paragraph)

C2.worst_defect: The home comparison table says the demo sends "anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com, with no cookie": the domain belongs to a different brand and the home page never says whose server it is (only Connect a till calls it a self-hosted PostHog), so a newcomer reads it as an unexplained third party.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row; home/phone/04

C3.worst_defect: The quick start gives no estimate of the effort (nine numbered steps, two script files, a migration, CORS and tax strategy) before you begin, and step 2 opens with a naming caveat ("The plugin's code names say Tally, not VendurePOS") rather than progress, so a newcomer cannot tell up front whether this is a 10-minute or a 2-hour job.

C4.worst_defect: The setup docs have no images at all: quick-start, plugin-setup, connect-a-till and troubleshooting have no [image:] markers, so 'Sign in to Vendure', the header sync notices and 'Check it worked' ("the payment is tally-pos, settled") are described only in words, with no picture of the screen you should see.
C4.where: text/quick-start.txt, connect-a-till.txt, troubleshooting.txt (0 image markers); quick-start/desktop/04 'Check it worked'

C5.worst_defect: The payment-screen screenshot on At the till shows a test-fixture product, "Tally Fixture Mug" (€8.00), in the cart, which reads as leftover test data in an otherwise polished demo image.
C5.where: at-the-till/desktop/02 (payment screen screenshot, first cart line)

C6.worst_defect: In the phone hero screenshot the till's cart header "QTY" is truncated to "Q..."; everything else reflows well (the comparison table stacks into labelled rows, code wraps, no overflow).

C7.worst_defect: Mobile Lighthouse LCP is 2.4 s on / and 2.6 s on /docs/quick-start (score 0.88), with render-blocking requests and about 52 KiB of unused JavaScript flagged; titles, descriptions, OG card, JSON-LD, llms.txt, search API, sitemap, robots and the 404 page are all in order.

overall_worst.defect: On the home page, the only statement about data leaving the browser in the demo names "ph.wcpos.com", a domain from another brand with no explanation of who runs it, so a visitor who has never heard of VendurePOS meets an unexplained third party exactly where they are judging whether to trust the demo.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 and home/phone/04, 'Live demo or your own store' table, row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline'
overall_worst.fix: In that cell, say whose it is, for example "to our own self-hosted PostHog analytics (ph.wcpos.com, run by the WCPOS team that builds VendurePOS), with no cookie", keeping the link to the Connect a till explanation.
